judged_text: `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` is a no-op when evt.destinationCalendar is null, silently dropping all collective hosts' destination calendars in exactly the case where neither the eventType nor the organizer has one but team members do. For COLLECTIVE bookings whose eventType and organizer have no destinationCalendar, team members' calendars are never created-in, contradicting the PR's stated purpose of handling collective multiple hosts; the booking silently books only on... nothing.

adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Later, for COLLECTIVE team events, the code attempts `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`, which is a no-op when `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`. This means `teamDestinationCalendars` collected from other hosts (`users.slice(1)`) will be silently dropped in exactly that scenario, so those hosts' destination calendars won't be included in the event's `destinationCalendar` array passed into `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`.
